SELECT 0 AS type, ppo.id as produceOrderId, ppo.production_line_id as productLineId, ppo.material_id, ppo.code as produceOrderCode, any_value(ppo.material_code) as material_code, any_value(ppo.material_name) as material_name, pcsi.classes_id, sum( pcsi.quantity ) AS quantity, any_value(pcsi.unit_id) FROM pms_complete_storage pcs JOIN pms_complete_storage_info pcsi ON pcsi.complete_storage_id = pcs.id JOIN pms_produce_order ppo ON pcsi.produce_order_id = ppo.id WHERE pcsi.del_flag = 0 AND ppo.del_flag = 0
AND ppo.production_line_id in
#{productLineId}
AND pcs.enter_time >= #{start} AND pcs.enter_time <= #{end} GROUP BY ppo.id, ppo.production_line_id, ppo.material_id, pcsi.classes_id

SELECT prw.product_line_id, prw.station_id, prw.start_time as start, prw.end_time as end, prw.id as reportWorkId, ppo.material_id, prw.classes_id FROM pms_report_work prw JOIN pms_produce_order ppo ON prw.produce_order_id = ppo.id WHERE prw.start_time >= #{start} AND prw.start_time <= #{end}

SELECT prw.product_line_id, prw.classes_id, prw.class_date, prwh.start_time, prwh.end_time FROM pms_report_work prw LEFT JOIN pms_report_work_hour prwh ON prw.id = prwh.report_work_id WHERE prw.del_flag = 0 AND prw.class_date >= #{dto.startDate} AND prw.class_date <= #{dto.endDate} AND prwh.start_time IS NOT NULL AND prw.product_line_id IN
#{lineId}

SELECT ppo.id as produceOrderId, sum( pcsi.quantity ) AS quantity, pcs.enter_time AS enterTime, any_value(ppo.material_id) AS materialId, any_value(ppo.customer_id) AS customerId FROM pms_complete_storage pcs JOIN pms_complete_storage_info pcsi ON pcsi.complete_storage_id = pcs.id JOIN pms_produce_order ppo ON pcsi.produce_order_id = ppo.id WHERE pcsi.del_flag = 0 AND ppo.del_flag = 0 AND pcs.state != 2 AND pcs.enter_time >= #{start} AND pcs.enter_time <= #{end} GROUP BY ppo.id,pcs.enter_time
